thread:
Sam W: Quick FYI — weekly capacity readout attached. Low-level note: EU cluster eu-west-2 is trending ~18% above forecast for token-hours. Can we confirm spot replacement plans?
Priya R: Looking. Burn rate spiked after midnight tests, probably due to long-context evals. :eyes:
Diego M: Noted. EU preemptible pool is ~60% drained; we have ~24h runway at current qps.
Joan L: APAC (apac-south) steady, but network egress to US has increased ~30% — could hit cost alerts.
Sam W: Short table:
```
region | active GPUs | 24h GPU-hrs | runway (hrs)
EU     | 120        | 2880       | 24
US     | 200        | 4000       | 36
APAC   | 48         | 1152       | 48
```
Priya R: For EU, suggest shifting 8 GPUs from us-west burst pool into eu-west canary for 6h to dampen preemptions. Anyone opposed?
Diego M: +1, but need to update routing policy and rollback plan.
Joan L: I'll open the change and add a canary with traffic weight 5%.
infra-bot: Deploy job #deploy-982 started for canary routing update.
Sam W: Also, let's throttle nightly long-context evals to 50% at 02:00-04:00 UTC; lowers prefix cache pressure.
Priya R: Agreed. I'll update the autoscale policy: set max_surge=12, burst_target=8 for eu-west.
Diego M: Reminder: APAC VPC has MTU mismatch ticket — if we hit high batch sizes we'll see drops. Ticket #4321.
Joan L: Adding that to the incident watchlist.
Sam W: Action items:
- Priya: update autoscale + throttle evals (done by EOD)
- Joan: open canary + change (start in 15m)
- Diego: monitor spot replacement, escalate if runway <12h
- Infra-bot: post final runbook link when done

Priya R: I'll ping when autoscale policy is live. :thumbsup:
Diego M: Monitoring dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/gpu-runway?view=weekly
Sam W: Thanks team — plan to reconvene Monday if anything changes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
